source: REBASE (Roberts RJ, Vincze T, Posfai J, Macelis D) enzyme entries, http://rebase.neb.com/rebase/enz/<Enzyme>.html; recognition and (n1/n2) cut offsets read from those pages on the retrieval date, consistent with the NEB product listings for the same enzymes.
notes:
COORDINATE CONVENTION for cut_top / cut_bottom (both are 1-based counts measured from the first base of the recognition sequence, which is position 1 on the top strand):
  cut_top    = the number of bases retained on the top strand, i.e. the top-strand cut is the phosphodiester bond between base cut_top and base cut_top+1, counted from the 5' end of the recognition site.
  cut_bottom = the same for the bottom strand, expressed as the position of the last base of the bottom strand counted along the top-strand ruler (equivalently: the bottom-strand cut is between base cut_bottom and base cut_bottom+1 of the top strand).
  Therefore, for a site of length L with offset notation (n1/n2) as used by REBASE/NEB (e.g. GGTCTC (1/5)): cut_top = L + n1, cut_bottom = L + n2, spacer = n1, overhang_length = n2 - n1 = cut_bottom - cut_top.
  Because n1 < n2 for all six enzymes, the bottom strand extends further downstream and every enzyme here leaves a 5' overhang (overhang_strand = "5'"). The cut is always on the 3' side of the recognition sequence, i.e. downstream in the direction of the recognition sequence as written.
  To place cuts on the reverse-complemented site (bottom strand read 5'->3'), mirror the ruler: a cut at position p from the 5' end of the top-strand site becomes a cut L+1-p from the 5' end of the bottom-strand site.

BsaI.notes: Standard 4-nt-overhang Golden Gate enzyme. Non-palindromic Type IIS site.

BsmBI.notes: Same geometry as BsaI (isoschizomer of Esp3I). Non-palindromic Type IIS site.

BbsI.notes: 2-nt spacer between the recognition site and the top-strand cut. Non-palindromic Type IIS site.

SapI.notes: 7-bp recognition site; leaves a 3-nt 5' overhang. Non-palindromic Type IIS site.

BspQI.notes: Isoschizomer of SapI: identical recognition sequence and identical cut positions; 3-nt 5' overhang.

AarI.notes: 7-bp recognition site with a 4-nt spacer before the top-strand cut; 4-nt 5' overhang. Non-palindromic.
